description: Stage 4 / CODEX P0.1: Mirror Coat's beforeTurn deals its stored-damage counter-hit as a direct HP mutation (a side effect, unaffected by merging) but ALSO returns 'skip' to stop its own normal move that turn (bundle.deobfuscated.js:58164-58186 store, then the beforeTurn counter at ~58081-58146 region 'mirror_coat' branch). Merged, that return is discarded, so a Mirror-Coat holder both counters AND attacks normally the same turn -- a double-hit the unmerged (ability-only) case never produces. modifySpeed forces Mirror Coat to always move last, guaranteeing it gets hit before its own turn resolves within the same round.
